items.xivtodo: Duty completion tracker for dungeons, raids, and trials (less useful for the dailies checklist)
items.msqtracker: Main Scenario Quest progress tracker, kept current through Dawntrail (progress saves to your browser only; export/import to move it, no shareable link)
items.ffxivprogress: MSQ progress tracker; stopped receiving updates after Endwalker, so use MSQTracker above for anything post-Endwalker
items.ffxivcollect: Look up and compare minions, mounts, and other collectibles you're tracking
items.eurekatracker: Eureka NM pop time tracker, the community standard
items.paissadb: Tracks open housing plots and wards in real time, what I use to find and review options before bidding
items.housingplotviewer: Browse screenshots and views for every plot so you can judge whether you'd like it without visiting in game
items.ffxivvenues: Directory and schedule of player-run venues across NA/EU data centers
items.eorzeacollection: Vanilla (no-mod) glamour gallery. Browse and save outfits for in-game use
items.discord: Main way I message friends and stay in touch with the community (heavy daily use)
items.twitch: In-game event streams and DJ sets
items.xivresources: Exhaustive, uncurated directory of FFXIV sites, APIs, and dev tools, for when this list doesn't have it
items.chocobocalc: Plan out chocobo color breeding/feeding paths
items.xivstats: General-purpose database with datasets you won't find elsewhere, like desynthesis results. The housing viewer for plot numbers is what I use most
items.icyveins: Job guides. I use it for a default crossbar/hotbar setup when leveling a new class on controller
items.consolegameswiki: General item and quest info, easy to figure out what or how to go get something
items.retainerventures: List of every minion obtainable from retainer exploration ventures, and which venture unlocks each one
items.ffxivgardening: Hybrid seed crossbreeding paths. I use it for Thavnair onions
items.lodestone: Official news, maintenance, and lore updates
items.unicodereddit: Community-cataloged Unicode symbols that render in FFXIV chat and names
items.unicodegist: Broader Unicode reference table, linked to the FFXIV-relevant range
items.unicodelodestoneblog: Player-written Lodestone blog post listing special characters for names and chat
items.unicodewiki: Wiki page listing the special characters FFXIV's chat and name fields support
items.dalamud: Plugin framework for FFXIV client tools and mods. Install this first, everything else on this page runs through it
items.penumbra: Runtime mod loader, applies texture/model mods without touching game files. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.glamourer: Changes your character's outside appearance using Penumbra mods, what Glamaholic plates apply through. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.renireguide: Beginner-friendly walkthrough for setting up Penumbra and Glamourer to mod your character's appearance
items.bdth: Gizmo-based housing item positioning, far more precise than the in-game editor. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory.
items.glamaholic: Save and swap glamour plates. Import looks straight from Eorzea Collection or someone else's export, try them on, and apply via Glamourer. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.xivmodarchive: Biggest free mod repository: glamour, gear, and animation mods, installed via Penumbra
items.heliosphere: Second mod source/manager I check when Mod Archive doesn't have what I'm looking for
items.glamourdresser: Paid mod marketplace. I don't usually pay, but a lot of creators unpaywall mods after a while, so I browse their Patreons for stuff that's gone free
items.compressyourself: Step-by-step guide to compressing mod textures for Lightless/PlayerSync. Keeps synced mod sizes down
items.chat2: Complete in-game chat window rewrite: unlimited tabs, better filtering, RGB channel colors, unread counts. A must-have
items.umbraxiv: Fully customizable toolbars and 3D world markers. In the default plugin repo but hidden from browsing, so search the exact name to install
items.betterfriendlist: Cross-server friend list with FC-style login/logout notifications. The other person needs it installed too for you to see theirs
items.dalamudpluginbrowser: Better search/browse UI for what's available in the main plugin repo than Dalamud's own in-game list
items.punish: Plugin studio/publisher I pull from a lot: Artisan, AutoRetainer, Pandora's Box, and more. Their repo goes under Dalamud's Experimental settings.
items.thebalance: Job theorycrafting hub, rotation guides, discord
items.gamerescapewiki: General item, quest, and game info. Alternate to the Console Games Wiki
items.heavenswhere: Interactive maps for hunts, gathering nodes, aether currents, and treasure (currently showing a maintenance page, recheck before relying on it)
items.relictracker: Tracks relic weapon progress and what's still needed
items.sightseeinglog: Helper for the in-game Sightseeing Log bingo
items.oceanfishing: Upcoming ocean fishing voyage schedule, blue fish, and achievement info
items.ff14fish: Predicts weather/time windows for catching specific fish, the community standard for fishing spreadsheets
items.lifestream: Travel to another world, data center, or house with a single command. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory
items.aetherphone: Adds a full smartphone interface in-game, social feed, messaging, photo sharing, market board, games. Recreates a lot of a home-screen experience. Custom repo, not in the default plugin directory

index.tagline: A running list of things I actually use. Updated whenever I find something worth keeping.
index.searchPlaceholder: Search tools by name, description, or tag...
index.footerLine1: Found something I haven't tried? See the {watchlist}. Looking for plugins? See the {plugins}.

plugins.tagline: Dalamud plugins I actually use. Handy to have in one place when I'm recommending them to someone.
plugins.note: These are third-party client plugins run through {dalamud}, not officially supported by Square Enix. Install and use at your own judgment. Anything tagged {experimental} isn't in Dalamud's default plugin directory; you add it under Dalamud Settings → Experimental → Custom Plugin Repositories using the repo/URL linked below.
plugins.searchPlaceholder: Search plugins by name, description, or tag...

watchlist.tagline: Tools I've heard about or seen others use, but haven't tried myself. A holding place to explore later.
watchlist.note: Nothing here is a recommendation from me yet, it's a reminder to check these out. Once I've actually used one and it earns a spot, it moves to the {main}.
watchlist.searchPlaceholder: Search watchlist by name, description, or tag...
watchlist.emptyStateText: Nothing on the watchlist matches that search.
watchlist.footerLine1: Actually use one of these regularly? Move it to the {main}.

venues.tagline: Player-run venues I actually visit. Hours are converted to your local time automatically.
venues.note: Hours are posted by each venue in Eastern Time and shown here converted to your device's local time and weekday. Use the address button to copy a ready-to-paste {lifestream} travel command.
